authority.method_scope_warning: the target source anticipates the final PseudoDojo branch; this occurrence is the separately identified SSSP pilot and cannot satisfy that pseudopotential or independent-toolchain gate
authority.transfer_to_this_pilot: necessary intended-use screen, not an additive error-budget allocation; any later reduction is compared directly with its parent under separately bound criteria

parent_gamma_vbm.role: authenticated construction-point support datum; only the conduction-valley side of the gap is withheld

energy_reference.pointwise_spectral_residuals: common accepted-S1 parent native QE reference; no fitted scalar shift

frozen_candidate_prediction_source.contains: six candidate locations and energies plus curvature and effective-mass diagnostics at the declared scales

longitudinal_effective_mass.metric: abs(candidate - parent) / abs(parent) for every matched valley

transverse_effective_masses.metric: abs(candidate - parent) / abs(parent) for both transverse principal masses at every matched valley

valley_position.metric: Euclidean Cartesian reciprocal displacement between matched candidate and direct-parent minima

inconclusive_conditions: a matched parent minimum lies outside the sampled 0.04 inverse-angstrom capture radius
the local fit is rank deficient or fails its recorded conditioning check
the direct-parent conduction band cannot be tracked through the local sample
required eigenvalues are nonfinite or carry unconverged-eigenvalue diagnostics
a comparison denominator required by a relative metric is zero
intended_use: non-SOC bulk-silicon pilot and subsequent sp3s-star reduction

observable_conventions.gating_hessian: parent and candidate three-dimensional quadratic fits on the identical 0.002 inverse-angstrom stencil, matching the frozen candidate characterization's declared primary scale
observable_conventions.local_coordinates: Cartesian reciprocal displacement in inverse angstrom
observable_conventions.mass_tensor: full Cartesian inverse-mass tensor from the fitted energy Hessian, reported in free-electron-mass units
observable_conventions.principal_mass_labels: longitudinal is the principal direction with maximum absolute overlap with the matched signed cubic valley axis; the other two direction-matched principal values are transverse
observable_conventions.sensitivity_hessians: separate fits at 0.005 and 0.010 inverse angstrom are reported but do not replace the prospective primary-scale comparison
observable_conventions.spectral_residual: gauge-invariant optimal injective matching of the rank-10 candidate spectrum into the 12 direct-parent eigenvalues; the matching is reported and no operator subtraction is performed
observable_conventions.tracked_band: lowest conduction state, tracked continuously within each candidate-conditioned valley neighborhood
observable_conventions.valley_fit: direct-parent minimum from the joint three-dimensional quadratic fit over points no farther than 0.010 inverse angstrom from the frozen candidate center

reported_non_gating_comparisons: injectively matched spectral maximum, RMS, and 95th-percentile error
Hessian and mass sensitivity across declared stencil scales
scope_note: failure means inadequate for this declared intended use under the adopted targets; it does not mean the finite operator is intrinsically invalid
